title: What are Loops?
overview: Loops are used to execute a block of code repeatedly until a specific condition becomes false. They help avoid writing the same code multiple times.

title: for Loop
overview: The for loop is commonly used when the number of iterations is known. It contains initialization, condition, and increment/decrement parts.

title: while Loop
overview: The while loop executes code as long as the given condition remains true. It is useful when the number of iterations is not fixed.

title: do...while Loop
overview: The do...while loop executes the code block at least once before checking the condition.

title: break and continue
overview: break is used to stop a loop completely, while continue skips the current iteration and moves to the next one.
